target: same person AND visit clinical tft_tug seconds; not inferred scores
population: subset of prior 298 people at their already selected visit; no visit or person replacement
task_choice: first QC-eligible matching original session preferred, then cone before line, then session/name; all candidates audited
turn_detection: pelvis yaw relative to median first 0.5s, unwrapped and 0.25s moving average; first 90degree crossing at >60% of 99th-percentile radial excursion from initial position; preceding20 and following160deg crossings, padded0.25s on both ends; excursion>=1.5m, endpoints>=45% excursion, subsequent return<=65%; duration0.3..27s before padding

qc.interpretation: heuristic kinematic plausibility screen, not original RGB tracking validation

event_matched.walk: first3s old input and first(3+D)s from SAME old start
event_matched.turn: complete detected central140degree turn plus0.5s margins; D its duration
event_matched.observation: WalkMatched3+D seconds versus Walk3Turn3+D seconds, two separate recordings; no full TUG elapsed time feature

fixed6.walk: first3s and first6s from same old start
fixed6.turn: 3s centered on first90degree crossing; may not encompass full turn
fixed6.observation: 6 seconds for matched straight and 3+3; event-matched cohort evaluated separately

training: RF128trees leaf2/5 selected by inner MAE; explicit uniform sample weights; train-only standardization; 5 frozen person partitions x3 seeds; old outer and inner splits restricted to cohort, never reallocated
tail: TUG>=20seconds descriptive band, not a clinical threshold; alleligible people predicted regardless of target
analysis: MAE, signedbias, positive underestimation, RMSE per band and per person; paired person bootstrap of across-run errors conditional on fits; no claims of independent final validation
limits: same-visit label does not establish which cone/line trial the stopwatch label refers to
TUG turn is a part of the target assessment, not independent SPPB inference
window location and source IK use full recordings; observation budget refers to model-input motion, not recording duration
quality filtering changes population; excluded long people explicitly enumerated
